source_findings.finding: The inventory covers the visible history count/toggle, snapshot selection, Live return, and Summary (text), For AI agent, and JSON copy choices. JSON is marked admin-only in the component options.

Existing T06 overstates the source-visible empty/loading/error experience. The history control only renders when rows exist; the query returns an empty array both for a missing relation and for other errors, and the component has no distinct history loading/error message or retry control. These remain unverified source limitations, not omitted actionable controls.
